head.lead: Listen to your raw mic and to Wave Link at the same time while you change your settings, and see right away what each change does. Nothing is recorded.
head.note: If the raw mic can't be opened while Wave Link is running, use only the Wave Link output: you still see level, pauses and tone.

entry.guideText: Changed your settings? Fine-tune them while you talk and watch your level and tone move.

devices.none: None — only the Wave Link output
devices.enable: Turn on the microphone to list your inputs.

error.unsupported: This browser can't listen to two inputs live. Use a recent Chrome, Edge or Firefox.
error.permission: The browser didn't allow the microphone. Allow it for this page and try again.
error.rawUnavailable: Your raw mic couldn't be opened. Check that it is plugged in, or use only the Wave Link output.
error.fxUnavailable: The Wave Link output couldn't be opened. Check that Wave Link is running and pick its output again.
error.sameDevice: Both choices are the same input. Pick your raw mic in one and the Wave Link output in the other.
error.other: Live listening stopped because of an unexpected error. Try starting again.
error.useFxOnly: Use only the Wave Link output

read.title: Read the text out loud
read.text: Talk normally, as if you were streaming. The panels fill in after a second or two.

loudness.title: Loudness
loudness.meter: Level meter from -60 to 0 dBFS. Target range {{min}} to {{max}} dBFS.
loudness.clip_one: Clipping in {{count}} moment in the last 4 s
loudness.clip_other: Clipping in {{count}} moments in the last 4 s

pauses.title: Pauses
pauses.none: Pause for a moment to measure the room noise.
pauses.dead: {{pct}}% dead silence: noise removal too strong

tone.title: Tone
tone.lead: Centre line = your goal. Hollow dot = raw mic, filled dot = Wave Link.
tone.keepTalking: Keep talking to see your tone
tone.row: {{band}}: Wave Link {{fx}} dB from your goal
tone.rowRaw: {{band}}: raw mic {{raw}} dB, Wave Link {{fx}} dB from your goal

hints.title: Try now
hints.empty: Nothing to change right now. Keep talking.

hint.talkMore: Keep reading out loud: we need about a second of your voice before we can suggest anything.
hint.noRawSync: We can't line up the two inputs: check that the raw mic is the same microphone Wave Link uses.
hint.tooLoud: Your voice is too loud and can distort: turn ReaComp Wet down about {{db, number(maximumFractionDigits: 1)}} dB.
hint.tooQuiet: Your voice is too quiet: turn ReaComp Wet up about {{db, number(maximumFractionDigits: 1)}} dB. If it is already high, raise your mic gain instead.
hint.deadSilence: Your pauses drop to dead silence, so the effects are cutting into your voice: turn the noise removal down a step, or lower the ReaGate Threshold. Pauses should sound quiet, not dead.
hint.noiseNotReduced: The room between your words is about as loud as on the raw mic, so the noise removal is barely working: check that it is on in Wave Link, then turn it up a step.
hint.stillNoisy: You can still hear the room between your words: turn the noise removal up a step, or move a little closer to the mic.

toneHigh.boom: Too much boom: lower the ReaEQ Low Shelf at 150 Hz by about {{db, number(maximumFractionDigits: 1)}} dB.
toneHigh.warmth: Your voice sounds thick: lower the ReaEQ Band at 250 Hz by about {{db, number(maximumFractionDigits: 1)}} dB.
toneHigh.mud: Your voice sounds muddy or boxy: lower the ReaEQ Band at 450 Hz by about {{db, number(maximumFractionDigits: 1)}} dB.
toneHigh.presence: Your voice sounds harsh: lower the ReaEQ Band at 3500 Hz by about {{db, number(maximumFractionDigits: 1)}} dB.
toneHigh.sibilance: Your S sounds are sharp: lower the ReaEQ High Shelf at 10 kHz by about {{db, number(maximumFractionDigits: 1)}} dB.

toneLow.boom: Your voice lacks bass: raise the ReaEQ Low Shelf at 150 Hz by about {{db, number(maximumFractionDigits: 1)}} dB.
toneLow.warmth: Your voice sounds thin: raise the ReaEQ Band at 250 Hz by about {{db, number(maximumFractionDigits: 1)}} dB.
toneLow.mud: Your voice sounds hollow: raise the ReaEQ Band at 450 Hz by about {{db, number(maximumFractionDigits: 1)}} dB.
toneLow.presence: Your voice sounds dull or far away: raise the ReaEQ Band at 3500 Hz by about {{db, number(maximumFractionDigits: 1)}} dB.
toneLow.sibilance: Your voice lacks crispness: raise the ReaEQ High Shelf at 10 kHz by about {{db, number(maximumFractionDigits: 1)}} dB.

hint.rawSilent: Your raw mic is silent while you talk: pick the microphone itself (for example Wave XLR) as the raw mic, or choose None.
